answer: Prisoner Hudson faces sexual harassment, seeking move; appeal upcoming.
evidence: ["Tara Hudson, 26, from Bath, was jailed at the all-male HMP Bristol for 12 weeks after admitting assault. Her supporters claim it has placed her in danger of sexual violence and more than 110,000 people have signed a petition calling for her to be moved. Her appeal will be heard on Friday.", "Hudson's mother said she was being sexually harassed by other prisoners. Jackie Brooklyn said her daughter was 'constantly' having sexual taunts shouted at her in the jail."]
